# The adapter restarts itself: `restart` with the launch arguments, then
# the configuration again after the new initialized.
> initialize
< {"body": {"supportsConfigurationDoneRequest": true, "supportsRestartRequest": true}}
> launch
< {}
< event initialized
> configurationDone
< {}
> restart {"arguments": {"program": "/w/app"}}
< {}
< event initialized
> configurationDone
< {}
< event terminated
> disconnect
< {}
